# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We want Palworks to be a welcoming, friendly, and harassment-free project for everyone,
regardless of experience level or background. Maintainers and contributors are expected to treat
each other with respect and good faith.

## Our standards

In short:

- **Be respectful and constructive.** Critique ideas and code, not people.
- **Be welcoming.** Assume good intent and help newcomers get up to speed.
- **Keep it on-topic and professional** in issues, pull requests, and discussions.

Behavior that harasses, demeans, or excludes others is not acceptable and may result in removal of
contributions and a ban from project spaces, at the maintainers' discretion.

## Adopting the Contributor Covenant

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/), version
2.1. The full text — including the detailed standards and enforcement guidelines — is available at:

https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/

## Reporting

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, please report it by opening a private report
to the maintainer via GitHub, or by contacting the repository owner directly through their GitHub
profile. All reports will be reviewed and handled confidentially.
